items.t: What Could Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) FDA Cancer Approval Change For Investors?
items.sum: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) received FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO for advanced head and neck cancer in adults. The therapy is cleared for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma after platinum chemotherapy and anti-PD-(L)1 treatment. RYBREVANT FASPRO is described as a first in class, dual targeted option for patients with limited second line treatment choice
